known_prior_results: Frozen v1 results and the completed Quanta pooled/task results are known. This extension remains exploratory.
seed_selection: First three frozen v1 seed IDs in protocol order, never ranked by economic outcomes. All ten existing seed results remain preserved as diagnostics.
matched_generation_budget: Three trajectories per pool, each290scheduled search rounds and870planned candidates. Actual LLM parsing/admission counts are retained and reported; no successful-only replacement. Grammar has a narrower fixed hypothesis space.
control_library: Recover every accepted code and its discovery date from byte-verified frozen v1 archive artifacts; independently re-account existing weights and verify every selected factor was available. No old search/model rerun. Pool with identical all-accepted union, source-code deduplication, earliest-discovery gate, source evaluator/ranking/normalization/portfolio/fees as LLM pools.
primary_efs_contrasts: Each causal-discovery-gated three-trajectory LLM pool minus the causal-discovery-gated three-trajectory grammar pool at10bp, exact2019–2024dailycalendar, aggregated to72complete calendar months. No hindsight primary.
other_controls: Initial library, equal-weight universe, ten-single-grammar-seed paths, every individual LLM trajectory, and0/25/50bp stress are retained as descriptive comparisons. They do not replace the matched pool based on returns.

inference.multiplicity: Preserve previously frozen native two-contrast results as local-study results. Add a stricter four-contrast project-wide Holm correction when all four exist; a completed subset gets4*p conservative Bonferroni upper bounds. Missing contrasts never disappear from denominator. EFS local two-contrast values can be diagnostic only. Degenerate comparisons usep1.
inference.limits: Conditional on libraries and shared historical market paths; model/control trials are not independent histories. Four18-month blocks assume approximate independent normal estimates; prior calibration is diagnostic, not universal coverage.

jkp.unrestricted_regression: Report not_identified for72observations versus134intercept/coefficients; never fit a pseudoinverse and call it unrestricted alpha.

regularized_projection.label: Expanding training-only coefficients/scaling/PCA, but contemporaneous factor returns reconstruct the current return difference. Attribution diagnostic, NOT a tradable forecast and NO unrestricted-alpha pvalue.

allocation.claims: Fixed synthetic gross-factor allocation diagnostic; agent internal10bp costs included, factor internal turnover/financing/allocation-change costs absent. Not a deployable net fund, best attainable frontier or unrestricted spanning test. Agent and factor monthly-return conventions retained explicitly.
